# watch: `WatchEvent`

The `data` payload of each line of `openreadout watch DIR` (also the `events[]` of the MCP tool `openreadout_watch`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

One line of `watch` output.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/watch.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/watch.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema watch`.

## Types

### EventKind

Kinds of events.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"dataset_new"` | A data set was seen for the first time (or reappeared). |
| `"plane_new"` | A new complete image plane. |
| `"scan_new"` | A new mass-spectrometry scan. |
| `"frame_new"` | A new sweep (frame) of a trace: electrophysiology sweeps, NMR FIDs. |
| `"dataset_complete"` | The data set is finished: every end-of-file structure is written and it stopped changing. |
| `"dataset_stalled"` | A data set still being written has not grown for `stall_after` (or was interrupted). |
| `"qc"` | A QC rule fired. |
| `"error"` | A data set could not be read. |

### QcFinding

A fired rule.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rule` | `string` | yes | Rule name. |
| `metric` | [`Metric`](#metric) | yes | Metric measured. |
| `value` | `number` (double) | yes | Measured value. |
| `bound` | `string` | yes | `min` or `max`: which bound was crossed. |
| `threshold` | `number` (double) | yes | The bound's value. |
| `description` | `string` or `null` |  | The rule's description. |
| `saturation_level` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | `saturated_fraction` only: the sample value counted as saturated (2^bits − 1 from the file's recorded bit depth, else the pixel type's maximum). |

### Metric

A QC metric.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"saturated_fraction"` | Fraction of samples at the detector's ceiling (recorded bit depth, else the pixel type's maximum). |
| `"sharpness_ratio"` | Plane sharpness relative to the first planes of the same image and channel. |
| `"interval_ratio"` | Gap before a new time point relative to the median gap. |
| `"tic_ratio"` | MS1 total ion current relative to the first MS1 scans. |

### ErrorBody

Structured error body. `hint` is meant to be actionable by an agent.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Stable code: `unknown_format`, `unsupported_feature`, `corrupt_file`, `usage`, `io`, `error`, `internal_panic` (a bug: the tool panicked; please report it). |
| `message` | `string` | yes | Human-readable description of the failure. |
| `hint` | `string` or `null` |  | What to try next, when the tool knows. |
| `exit_code` | `integer` (int32) | yes | The process exit code for this error (see the crate docs). |
